decisions.reason: The request adds missing local 3D model files to the portable KiCad project; it does not change BOM contents, part numbers, population rules, or assembly readiness.
This Requirement concerns sensor-board fabrication and assembly exports, whereas the source requests integrated-board 3D model dependencies for KiCad portability.
Supplying project-local 3D model files does not alter JLCPCB ordering assistance, account setup, component availability review, or order sequencing.
The source identifies missing CAD model files, not unavailable, costly, or unsuitable physical components, so the component-selection policy remains unchanged.
The requested 3D models correspond to USB1, Q3, and S1 and do not change the ESP32 module model, pin breakout, pitch, or reuse requirements.
The portable-project dependency request does not change addressable LED supply voltage, direct data drive, or level-shifter requirements.
Missing KiCad component models do not establish any change to enclosure contents, mounting, airflow, assembly, or board-orientation constraints.
The request for three 3D model files does not affect DCDC1 configuration, voltage compensation, or the regulated 3.3V rail.
The source does not change the e-paper backlight load, switching circuit, PWM control, supply selection, or component population.
Adding missing 3D model dependencies does not alter high-current nets, copper-path continuity, current capacity, or stitching-via requirements.
The source concerns unrelated integrated-board component models and does not change the SPS30 SEL connection or required I2C mode.
The requested model files are for integrated-board references USB1, Q3, and S1 and do not change the indicator board's LED count, model, package, or part number.
